backend/main.mo: Motoko canister storing user profiles, encrypted events, and tasks with permission checks and CRUD operations scoped by caller principal.
feature_evidence.json: Structured feature evidence report linking implemented fixes to file paths, components, and requirement IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of each frontend file in the project.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base setup defining OKLCH color variables for light and dark themes and global background/foreground styling.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/api/calendarMutations.ts: React Query mutation hooks for creating, updating, and deleting encrypted events and tasks with automatic cache invalidation.
frontend/src/api/calendarQueries.ts: React Query hooks that fetch and decrypt events and tasks using session-scoped query keys to avoid stale data after login changes.
Implements encrypt/decrypt helpers for events and tasks using AES-GCM along with decrypted type interfaces. Handles conversion between encrypted and plaintext calendar data.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Top-level React component managing auth, profile setup, unlock flow, actor readiness, and logout cleanup before rendering the app shell.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginScreen: UI for signing in via Internet Identity, showing encryption benefits and a login button. Displays loading state during authentication.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Modal prompting the user for their name and saving the profile. Handles validation, submission, and success/error toasts.
frontend/src/components/crypto/Passphras: Modal for entering a passphrase to unlock the encryption key. Shows validation errors and provides logout option.
frontend/src/components/layout/Shell.tsx: Main application shell with header, tabs for events and tasks, and lock/logout actions. Loads user profile and manages encryption session resets.
frontend/src/crypto/cryptoTypes.ts: Defines types for encrypted payloads and stored user salt. Used in encryption and key-derivation logic.
frontend/src/crypto/useEncryptionSession: Manages encryption session state using zustand, including unlock via key derivation, locking, and automatic reset on identity change.
frontend/src/crypto/webCrypto.ts: Implements PBKDF2 key derivation, AES-GCM encryption/decryption, random salt generation, and localStorage salt management.
frontend/src/features/events/EventCard.t: Displays an event card with formatted date/time, description, and actions to edit or delete. Includes dialogs for editing and confirming deletion.
frontend/src/features/events/EventFormDi: Modal form for creating or editing encrypted events, handling validation and submission to addEvent.
Displays the events list with loading, error, and empty states and controls opening the event creation dialog.
frontend/src/features/tasks/TaskCard.tsx: Renders a task with completion toggle, edit and delete actions, and optional deadline and details.
frontend/src/features/tasks/TaskFormDial: Modal form for creating or editing encrypted tasks, including optional deadline handling and mutation submission.
frontend/src/features/tasks/TasksView.ts: Shows active and completed tasks with loading/error states and provides a dialog to add new tasks.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor based on the user’s identity and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserProfile: Hooks for fetching and saving the caller’s user profile using the backend actor with react‑query.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements a React context/provider and hook wrapping DFINITY AuthClient to manage Internet Identity login state, stored identities, and login/logout actions.
frontend/src/index.css: Re-exports the root index.css file for styling.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, setting up React Query and wrapping the app in the InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers for reading URL parameters, persisting them in sessionStorage, and cleaning them from URL hashes.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending theme colors, animations, container settings, and enabling plugins.
project_state.json: JSON metadata describing the project state, features, and versioning for an ICP full‑stack starter app.
